existing evaluations focus almost exclusively on (final-answer) correctness, overlooking the importance of reliability in mathematical reasoning

we then filter out examples where the incorrectness of the perturbed statement could be inferred from prior work
we include a lightweight author-verification step to confirm that the paper's authors have prior publications in the relevant area
a member of our team reviews the remaining problems and removes cases where the extraction may be inaccurate
We evaluate models using their default parameters and a deliberately simple prompt
